title: Q-MANAGERS-closure: three managers file more than they close: most of their items end shelved
body:
**Owner:** program-manager
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation managers --closure
**Status:** closed

MANAGERS-1, DISPOSE-1. `python3 -m foundation managers --closure` (docs/issues by owner, 2026-11-25): infrastructure-manager 11 ended, 9 shelved (82%); portfolio-manager 23 ended, 17 shelved (74%); reviewer 10 ended, 7 shelved (70%). Shelved means the time limit closed the item and no probe passed: the loop was not closed, it was put away. Across all owners the ledger reads 310 shelved against 162 fixed (dispose --report).

For each shelved item of these three owners: run its closing probe; where the probe is vacuous or cannot fail, rewrite it; where the work is real, split it to a size the executor ships (PATCH-EDIT-1) and requeue; where it is not, supersede it with evidence. A manager whose filer keeps producing items nothing can close has its filer changed (same failure twice: mutate the approach). Do not raise max_shelved_share in doctrine/managers.json to pass. Prediction: no manager over the share within 14 days.

size: M

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation managers --closure.


**Prediction:** spec_quality >= 0.7 within 336 h (read by `python3 -m foundation specgate --report`; this item closing by its done check keeps the share of well-specified open items at or above today's reading)

**Out of scope:** removing a manager, switching one off to clear the reading, or changing the thresholds in doctrine/managers.json.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T05:33:04Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
